html_source: An April 1921 photograph held in the National Library of Ireland shows a horsedrawn hearse leading the funeral procession for Archbishop William Walsh around Dunphy's (Doyle's) corner from the North Circular Road onto the Phibsborough Road en route to the Glasnevin cemetery. Automobiles follow, but no funeral tram is seen rolling along the tracks. Source: www.flickr.com.
